en: You look tired out, dear. Sit down for a minute and let your Pokémon rest.
There, all better. Off you go, and be careful out there!

The PC is on. There's a message from a friend
asking how the journey is going.
A tidy kitchen. Something good is in the oven.
A potted plant. Someone waters it every day.

A map of Unova. Aspertia City is marked
in the bottom corner.

A calendar. The days of the seasons are
marked in four colours.
